messages:
Alyssa (People Ops): Quick heads-up — planning a staggered summer partial shutdown (Aug 5-16) to reduce full blackouts but keep coverage during product launch week. Read below for opt-in rules and blackout overlap.

Sophia (People Ops): Key rules: max 5 consecutive PTO days during the window, carryover cap unchanged, auto-approval cutoff July 28 for manager approvals. Exceptions required for release/oncall owners.

Mike R.: If I'm on-call rotation those weeks can I still take PTO? Need overlap with release (Aug 9 deploy).

Jordan - Eng: We have a major deploy Aug 9-10 — is that a blackout? Can't be on PTO those days.

Alyssa (People Ops): Good q. Release week (Aug 9-11) is a soft blackout — managers should only approve if alternate coverage is arranged. Please add coverage in the sheet: https://docs.google.com/example-signup (internal sign-up).

Mike R.: I'll swap with Priya for Aug 9 if that helps. @Priya you good?

Priya (Eng): Yep happy to cover Aug 9, thanks Mike.

Sophia (People Ops): Process: submit PTO in HR portal as usual, then toggle the `Summer Opt-in` tag. Managers will get auto-notify; if no manager action by July 28 it's auto-approved unless you have release/oncall responsibilities.

Jordan - Eng: Any changes to carryover balances? I've been saving for Sept.

Sophia (People Ops): No changes to accrual or carryover policy. Carryover cap is still 40 hours. Note: unused 'Summer Opt-in' PTO doesn't convert to payout.

Alyssa (People Ops): For extended leaves or managerial exceptions, file the exception form: https://intranet.company/forms/pto-exception and cc your manager + People Ops.

ops-bot: Reminder — submit coverage by July 30 or your opt-in may be bumped subject to capacity.

Alyssa (People Ops): TL;DR: Aug 5-16 staggered PTO ok, release week Aug 9-11 soft blackout, auto-approve cutoff July 28, carryover unchanged. Ping me with questions. :sun_with_face:
